sourceTitle: How Enron Made Its Money Disappear
title: Enron Booked Profit It Never Earned
hook: Enron booked profit on money it had not earned yet.
question: Should that ever have been legal?

scenes.narration: Enron booked profit on money it had not earned yet. Sometimes money it never would.
The trick was mark-to-market accounting. Sign a deal, then book years of projected profit immediately, as if the cash were already in.
scenes.sub: count future projections as today's cash

scenes.narration: They booked a hundred ten million in profit on one deal. The deal flopped. The profit stayed on the books.
scenes.label: booked as profit anyway

scenes.narration: All told, six hundred million dollars in profit that was never real.
scenes.label: later erased

scenes.narration: Should that ever have been legal?
